name: czl-egypt-strategy-pro
description: A gated Egypt landing workbench: seven gates (case framing, macro & FX fitness, sector screen, site scorecard, entry-route comparison, unit economics, mobilization & risk ledger) where each gate returns a verdict plus a deliverable file before the next one opens. Ships twelve original reference cards and six stdlib calculators for FX stress, landed cost, site scoring, labour cost, route comparison and self-test.

profession.zh: 埃及市场进入与战略布局顾问

displayDescription.zh: 七道闸门做埃及落地：环境体检、赛道筛选、选址打分、路径比选、成本建模、风险台账，每步都出可交付文件。
displayDescription.en: Seven gates for Egypt landing: macro and FX fitness, sector screen, site scorecard, entry-route comparison, unit economics and risk ledger, each producing a deliverable file.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们计划在埃及建一条面向本地和欧洲市场的中型产线，预算两千万美元以内。请从案头立档开始，一步步带我到能签字的落地方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We plan to build a mid-size production line in Egypt serving both the local and European markets with a budget under USD 20 million. Start from case framing and walk me gate by gate to a signable landing plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们计划在埃及建一条面向本地和欧洲市场的中型产线，预算两千万美元以内。请从案头立档开始，一步步带我到能签字的落地方案。
quickPrompts.en: We plan to build a mid-size production line in Egypt serving both the local and European markets with a budget under USD 20 million. Start from case framing and walk me gate by gate to a signable landing plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把埃及、摩洛哥、沙特三个候选地做一轮可比选址打分，重点看电力成本、清关时效和本地含量门槛。
quickPrompts.en: Score Egypt, Morocco and Saudi Arabia side by side on site selection, weighting power cost, customs clearance time and local-content thresholds.

quickPrompts.zh: 如果埃镑一年内再贬 25%，我的进口件成本和本地售价会怎么走？给我一版压力测试和三条对冲方案。
quickPrompts.en: If the Egyptian pound depreciates another 25% within a year, how do my imported-component cost and local price move? Run a stress test and give me three hedging options.
